original_draft_fields.meaning: Black forces and Toussaint’s shifting alliances defeated foreign intervention and created autonomy beyond French control, without ending racial conflict. Bonaparte’s reconquest captured Toussaint, but disease, renewed black resistance after news of slavery’s restoration, and renewed Anglo-French war defeated French control. Haiti declared independence in 1804.
original_draft_fields.stance: Slavery was restored in other French colonies but never re-established in Saint-Domingue. Toussaint remained formally loyal to France while beyond its control; black military ascendancy did not ensure racial harmony. The author calls Haiti the only independent state directly created by the French Revolution, distinguishing later Latin American independence precipitated by Napoleon.

prior_review_fields.meaning: Black forces and Toussaint’s shifting alliances defeated foreign intervention and created autonomy beyond French control, without ending racial conflict. Bonaparte’s reconquest captured Toussaint, but disease, renewed black resistance after news of slavery’s restoration, and renewed Anglo-French war defeated French control. Haiti declared independence in 1804.
prior_review_fields.stance: Slavery was restored in other French colonies but never re-established in Saint-Domingue. proposed_fields.meaning: Black military forces expelled Spanish intervention, while British forces withdrew in 1798 after lethal disease and climate cost about 13,000 lives. Toussaint’s shifting alliances created autonomy beyond French control without ending racial conflict. Bonaparte’s reconquest captured Toussaint, but disease, renewed black resistance after news of slavery’s restoration elsewhere, and renewed Anglo-French war defeated French control. Haiti declared independence in 1804.
proposed_fields.stance: Do not combine Spanish expulsion and British withdrawal into one claim of black military victory. Slavery was restored in other French colonies but never re-established in Saint-Domingue. Toussaint remained formally loyal to France while beyond its control; his capture, subsequent resistance and independence are distinct phases and actors. Black military ascendancy did not ensure racial harmony. The author calls Haiti the only independent state directly created by the French Revolution, distinguishing later Latin American independence precipitated by Napoleon.

subject_field_corrections.rationale: Supersedes the overbroad foreign-intervention phrase in this reviewer’s sealed proposed parent; prior packet remains immutable. Source413 explicitly distinguishes British disease/withdrawal from the Spanish expulsion on412.

original_draft_fields.meaning: Roux, Varlet and associated militants challenged economic hardship and the limits of representative government through subsistence and popular-sovereignty demands before being marginalized and suppressed.
original_draft_fields.stance: Their pressure influenced radical politics but they were neither a coherent national party nor identical with Hébertists or all sansculottes.

prior_review_fields.meaning: Roux, Varlet and associated militants challenged economic hardship and the limits of representative government through subsistence and popular-sovereignty demands before being marginalized and suppressed.
prior_review_fields.stance: Their pressure influenced radical politics but they were neither a coherent national party nor identical with Hébertists or all sansculottes.

proposed_fields.meaning: Roux, Varlet and associated militants challenged economic hardship and the limits of representative government through subsistence and popular-sovereignty demands. Revolutionary authorities appropriated much of their programme before marginalizing and suppressing them; suppression also silenced their demand to activate the Constitution of 1793.
proposed_fields.stance: Their pressure influenced radical politics but they were neither a coherent national party nor identical with Hébertists or all sansculottes. Programme appropriation, elimination of militants and silencing of constitutional demands are distinct effects; suppression alone did not cause the formal suspension of the constitution.

subject_field_corrections.rationale: Preserves the precise constitutional effect against old positive-support or sole-cause normalizations; related reviewed historical key legacy:REL-9322CA8BFD17. Lead owns its separate historical key.

proposed_fields.meaning: Pressure against émigré bases, Brissotin claims that war would consolidate the Revolution, royal counter-revolutionary hopes, and Austrian-Prussian diplomacy produced the declaration of war on 20 April 1792. original_draft_fields.meaning: Sansculotte mobilization pushed emergency social and coercive measures through the Convention, but incorporation into the state and the destruction of the Hébertists ended independent popular political power. Paid twice-weekly attendance widened working people’s access while ending permanent sessions. Exhaustion, delivery of economic demands and paid public employment reduced autonomous mobilization. The Commune purge and dissolution of the Paris Revolutionary Army transferred coercive power to government.
original_draft_fields.stance: Do not reduce the sansculottes to a uniformly bloodthirsty bloc; their support shifted as much of their program was implemented and exhaustion set in. This marks the defeat of autonomous popular power, not the end of the Terror: the source expressly anticipates a harsher governmental phase.

prior_review_fields.meaning: Sansculotte mobilization pushed emergency social and coercive measures through the Convention, but incorporation into the state and the destruction of the Hébertists ended independent popular political power. Paid twice-weekly attendance widened working people’s access while ending permanent sessions. Exhaustion, delivery of economic demands and paid public employment reduced autonomous mobilization. prior_review_fields.stance: Do not reduce the sansculottes to a uniformly bloodthirsty bloc; their support shifted as much of their program was implemented and exhaustion set in. proposed_fields.meaning: Sansculotte mobilization pushed emergency social and coercive measures through the Convention, but incorporation into the state, the destruction of the Hébertists and the Commune purge curtailed autonomous popular political power. Paid twice-weekly attendance widened working people’s access while ending permanent sessions. Exhaustion, delivery of economic demands and paid public employment reduced autonomous mobilization. Dissolution of the Paris Revolutionary Army transferred coercive power to government.
proposed_fields.stance: Do not reduce the sansculottes to a uniformly bloodthirsty bloc; their support shifted as much of their programme was implemented and exhaustion set in. On page 271 the author describes the March–April 1794 repression as ending them as a political force, while the later account describes renewed mobilization and a final destruction in Prairial 1795. Preserve these dated judgments instead of silently choosing one undifferentiated endpoint. Defeat of autonomous popular power did not end the Terror: a harsher governmental phase followed.

subject_field_corrections.rationale: Fresh full-page 271 reread and prior full290–295 reading preserve the source’s own differently dated endpoint judgments.

original_draft_record.rationale: Universal liberation claims conflict with peaceful professions.

proposed_record.rationale: Exiles’ demands for armed liberation after Varennes conflicted with the Assembly’s professed rejection of offensive war and its reluctance to intervene immediately. Universal rights and rejection of dynastic alliances were not inherently inconsistent with peaceful professions.

before_record.evidence_summary: Roux and Varlet were arrested and Leclerc disappeared as the radicals eliminated rival advocates of the policies they adopted.

proposed_record.evidence_summary: Roux and Varlet were arrested and Leclerc disappeared as radical authorities eliminated rival advocates of policies they had adopted; this also silenced demands to activate the Constitution of1793.

before_record.evidence_summary: Toussaint’s autonomy gave way to capture, but disease and renewed resistance defeated reconquest. News of the 1802 restoration of slavery changed black commanders’ loyalties; slavery remained unrestored in Saint-Domingue, which declared Haiti’s independence.

proposed_record.evidence_summary: British forces withdrew in1798 after lethal climate and disease cost about13,000 lives. Toussaint’s autonomy later gave way to capture; disease, renewed resistance after news of slavery’s restoration elsewhere and renewed Anglo-French war defeated French reconquest. Slavery remained unrestored in Saint-Domingue, which declared independence as Haiti in1804.

before_record.evidence_summary: State employment, achieved demands, fatigue, and the purge of the Commune ended the sansculottes as an independent political force.

proposed_record.evidence_summary: The author describes state employment, achieved demands, fatigue and the March–April1794 Commune purge as ending the sansculottes as an independent political force; this is a dated source judgment, distinct from the later Prairial1795 final-destruction account.
